# bhs87.com

> bhs87.com is the Balboa High School Class of 1987's site for its 40th reunion and its long-term class home online. Balboa High School was in Balboa, in the former Panama Canal Zone, Panama. The reunion takes place during the Canal Zone Reunion (CZR) in Panama City, Panama, January 17–24, 2027. The site is free for classmates.

## What classmates get by signing up

- Plan your reunion week in about two minutes: arrival and departure dates, the class's Yacht Club '87 Dinner/Dance (evening of Wednesday, January 20, 2027), and the CZR and MiEvento events you plan to attend or already have tickets for, all on one calendar with time clashes flagged.
- Group dashboard: which classmates are in Panama on which days, a heatmap of when most of the class is free, and the best mornings, afternoons and evenings to meet.
- Interest groups: pick or suggest outings (for example a Napoli lunch, charter deep-sea fishing, or a jog on the Amador Causeway). When enough classmates share one, it shows the best times, venue ideas and a group chat link, and a classmate can volunteer as Event Organizer.
- Ticket Watch: which CZR 2027 events on MiEvento are sold out or almost gone, with a link to buy.
- Not in the 1987 yearbook? Classmates coming to the reunion whose photo isn't in the '87 yearbook can add one to the Missing Photos page so the class can put a face to their name.

## How signing up helps the class

- More entries make the "best times to meet" more reliable for everyone.
- Organizers get real head-counts for dinners and outings.
- Claimed names make it easier to see who hasn't heard about the reunion yet.

## Who it's for

Members of the Balboa High School Class of 1987, including Honorary '87 classmates who were part of the class but didn't graduate with it. Names not on the roster can be added and are confirmed by the class organizers.

## Key dates

- January 17–24, 2027: Canal Zone Reunion (CZR), Panama City, Panama
- January 20, 2027 (evening): Yacht Club '87 Dinner/Dance
- January 9–30, 2027: planning window on bhs87.com for classmates arriving early or staying on

## Privacy

Classmates' email addresses are never published. The group dashboard and yearbook portraits are for classmates and are not meant to be indexed.
